## StockFlow · Critical stock owner alerts

Local, rule-based and $0 in OpenAI usage.

**Preview mode is enabled. No email is sent.**

1. Connect a Gmail OAuth2 credential on Send owner Gmail.
2. Check real supplier email addresses and review a manual preview.
3. Change mailEnabled to true in Settings and publish.

Low stock = zero units or at most 50% of the product's own reorder threshold. Messages are grouped per owner; successful deliveries have a 24-hour cooldown. Out-of-stock escalation sends immediately. Daily digest runs at 09:00 and open-order follow-up at 10:00 Asia/Kolkata. Reserved demo emails are skipped.

API login is stored only in an encrypted n8n credential. No OpenAI key is needed. Source: automations/README.md.
